messages:
elaine: Heads-up — planning Valerian Labs private deployment on dedicated slice next Tue 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need go/no-go and a model/runtime pin. Customer asked for zero downtime; we'll canary first. @sanjay @miguel @ops-oncall please ack and flag blockers. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/valerian-20260324

sanjay: Ack. Quick Q — can we start warmup at 01:45 instead of 02:00? gives more room for health checks.

elaine: Prefer 02:00 due to traffic window but 01:45 is OK if infra teams can be ready.

miguel: We need to pin runtime -> rtm-1.3.7-qp1 and quant-kernel v2 for this customer's model. I'll run a 10min performance canary against 2 hosts. No config migrations.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: valerian-private / slice-14 / canary group A 
```
Canary ID: VAL-20260324-CAN-1
Targets: 2 hosts
Image: rtm-1.3.7-qp1+quant2
Start: 1768005600
```

deploy-bot: Canary progress: host1 OK, host2 OK. Metrics: p95 latency 118ms (baseline 95ms), error rate 0.6% (<1% threshold). Observed small increased CPU on host2, <10%.

ops-oncall: Seeing same metrics in the oncall dashboard. 0.6% errors are acceptable. I'll be oncall and will open the incident channel at 01:30 UTC. Rollback runbook ready.

product-sr: Reviewed release notes; please add a bullet that we're pinning runtime -> rtm-1.3.7-qp1 and fallback -> hosted-small if performance regresses. Otherwise OK.

sanjay: :thumbsup: Approved. I approve the window and the runtime pin.

elaine: Great — locking window: 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC. Final rollback criteria: >2% error rate sustained for 5min or p95 latency >30% regression vs baseline for 5min. If triggered, immediate rollback to rtm-1.3.6.

miguel: I'll run preflight smoke tests 01:15-01:30 and post-canary synthetic load at 01:50. Sending test script to #eng-sre.

ops-oncall: Confirmed — incident channel #inc-valerian will be created at 01:30. I'll also enable extended logs for slice-14 and watch for KV cache thrash.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan saved: change-id VAL-20260324-01; canary started successfully. To execute rollout: `/deploy execute VAL-20260324-01 --target slice-14 --pin rtm-1.3.7-qp1`

elaine: Final note: customer requested that we keep a warm standby of previous version for 24h; ops, make sure rollback path preserves their state.

ops-oncall: Will preserve standby image and traffic shift scripts. All set on my end.

elaine: Thanks team. Proceeding to final prep. If anyone sees anything odd in the next 45m, flag it here.

sanjay: Oncall page & escalation plan reviewed. Good to go from infra side.

product-sr: Publishing release notes now and pinging Valerian PM.

miguel: Smoke tests green. Canary metrics stable. Ready for rollout at 02:00.

elaine: Closing thread — rollout approved and scheduled.
